lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

candidates.title: Carousel pick friend gallery
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection view into an interactive hero carousel layout with vibrant companion previews.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop-off at 60.9% and high median time (89s), indicating users struggle to pick a pet efficiently.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Browse available personalities and select your favorite companion.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pick friend screen retaining its functionality.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step (60.9%), but redesign requires full screen rework.

candidates.title: Interactive path teaser preview screen
candidates.change: Add a new animated preview screen right after the story intro demonstrating custom vs instant pets.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s, showing users get stuck deciding between preset pets and photo upload.

new_path_preview.headline: See How Your Desktop Pet Comes to Life
new_path_preview.body: Choose between instant adoptable pets or creating a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an onboarding preview screen.

candidates.score_note: New screen changes performed poorly in previous tests (-5.8%).

candidates.title: Generation progress estimate and tips
candidates.change: Show estimated waiting time and pet tips carousel on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s with 81.3% conversion, leaving users wondering if the app stalled.

components.text: Your pet will live directly on your desktop taskbar.

guard.reason: Valid time estimate and tips added to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high mean wait time (2336s) during generation.

candidates.title: Centered sign-in layout with account recovery callout
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a focused centered layout emphasizing cloud pet saving and restore options.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing after signing in again, showing confusion around cloud account binding.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in so your desktop pet is safely backed up and synced across installs.
sign_in.hint: Signing in connects this pet to your cloud profile.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails regarding missing pets.

candidates.title: Stage view desktop landing intro
candidates.change: Rebuild the final home intro into a stage layout showing the pet arriving directly on the user's desktop taskbar.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% with 3 support emails reporting pets not visible on desktop after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop to meet your new pet companion.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets steep finish drop-off (64.8%) backed by support emails.

candidates.title: Photo quality guidance checklist hint
candidates.change: Display explicit photo quality guidelines and sample images on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong due to poor photo uploads.

upload_photos.hint: For best results: use clear, front-facing photos with good lighting.

components.text: Clear face lighting & single pet focus

candidates.score_note: Simple hint fixing custom pet creation issues noted in support emails.

candidates.title: Simplified story intro headline
candidates.change: Shorten and clarify the initial story screen headline to get users into pet selection faster.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating slow engagement on the initial intro screens.

story.headline: Adopt Your Virtual Desktop Buddy
story.body: A cute virtual pet that lives on your screen, ready to play and work alongside you.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change to speed up decision time.

candidates.title: System tray ready notification alert
candidates.change: Enable native desktop notification alert when pet asset generation finishes in the background.
candidates.why: Waiting takes 201s median / 2336s mean, causing users to minimize or abandon the window while waiting.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize. We will notify you when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Valid ready notification added to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Directly tackles idle drop-outs during long background wait time.

candidates.title: First interaction welcome badge bonus
candidates.change: Display a decorative adoption certificate badge on the final welcome screen to celebrate completing setup.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 18.6%, requiring stronger completion momentum at the final step.

guard.reason: Valid adoption badge added to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Easy configuration change to add finish step momentum.

candidates.title: Shift certificate flow after waiting step
candidates.change: Move the adoption certificate presentation screen after the asset generation waiting screen so users get rewarded right before desktop launch.
candidates.why: Only 64.8% finish the final step; placing the rewarding certificate right before desktop launch boosts completion momentum.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

picked: Centered sign-in layout with account recovery callout

decisions.title: Centered sign-in layout with account recovery callout
